RocketLeague_Arena_Text_RazorIntro.after: KARDINAL: You watch the attack.\nI watch the choice before it.\pTry keeping a secret from my\nPSYCHIC team!$

RocketLeague_Arena_Text_RazorDefeat.after: You chose a line I hadn't seen.$

RocketLeague_Arena_Text_VexIntro.after: SHION: Still judging strength by\nappearances? My FAIRY team\penjoys correcting that mistake.$

RocketLeague_Arena_Text_VexDefeat.after: An unexpected outcome. I'll\nrevise my prediction.$

RocketLeague_Arena_Text_NovaIntro.after: MOJAY: Empty space? Look closer.\nMy GHOST team is already making\pitself at home under these\nlights!$

RocketLeague_Arena_Text_NovaDefeat.after: You didn't fall for our\ndisappearing act!$

RocketLeague_Arena_Text_KnellIntro.after: ATTRYCE: Hear the bell? That's\nour cue. My WATER team keeps\prolling until the final round!$

RocketLeague_Arena_Text_MakoIntro.after: MAKO: Plenty of challengers look\ncalm on the surface. Let's see\pwhat happens under pressure.$

RocketLeague_Arena_Text_MakoDefeat.after: You kept your head in deep\nwater.$

RocketLeague_Arena_Text_SableIntro.after: SABLE: You came looking for\nsomething exotic? My\pordinary-looking team has a few\nsurprises.$

RocketLeague_Arena_Text_JetIntro.after: JET: My team keeps its feet on\nthe ground. One clean opening,\pand we hit like a landslide!$

RocketLeague_Arena_Text_JetDefeat.after: You stopped us in our tracks!$

RocketLeague_Arena_Text_ViperIntro.after: VIPER: A little pressure, a\nlittle poison. I prefer a plan\pthat keeps working after the\nfirst hit.$

RocketLeague_Arena_Text_ViperDefeat.after: You cut off my plan before it\nspread!$

PokemonLeague_BrunosRoom_Text_LoreleiInt.after: LORELEI: The arena is warm, but\nmy team is quite at home. Keep\pyour composure when the cold\ncloses in.$

PokemonLeague_BrunosRoom_Text_BrunoIntro.after: BRUNO: Every step here took\neffort! Put that effort behind\pyour commands. Hoo hah!$

PokemonLeague_BrunosRoom_Text_AgathaIntr.after: AGATHA: OAK sent you out to\nlearn, did he? Let's see whether\pyou can surprise an old hand!$

PokemonLeague_BrunosRoom_Text_AgathaDefe.after: Hah! There is life in this old\nchallenge yet!$

PokemonLeague_BrunosRoom_Text_LanceIntro.after: LANCE: A dragon's strength needs\na trainer who can guide it. Show\pme how you guide your own team.$

PokemonLeague_BrunosRoom_Text_BrockIntro.after: BROCK: We began with fragments\nand questions. Now show me the\pfoundation you've built since\nMT. MOON.$

PokemonLeague_BrunosRoom_Text_MistyIntro.after: MISTY: We've come a long way\nfrom those currents! My team\pwon't hold back. Let's make some\nwaves!$

PokemonLeague_BrunosRoom_Text_MistyDefea.after: You found a way through every\nwave!$

PokemonLeague_BrunosRoom_Text_LtSurgeInt.after: LT. SURGE: Look who made the\nLEAGUE! Training's over, kid.\pShow me that voltage under\npressure!$

PokemonLeague_BrunosRoom_Text_LtSurgeDef.after: Now that's power you can rely\non!$

PokemonLeague_BrunosRoom_Text_ErikaIntro.after: ERIKA: How lovely to meet here.\nI can see how your team has\pgrown. May we share another\nlesson?$

PokemonLeague_BrunosRoom_Text_KogaIntro.after: KOGA: Fwahahaha! No volcanic\ntrial today. Only your allies\pand mine. Show me the strength\nof that bond!$

PokemonLeague_BrunosRoom_Text_BlaineIntr.after: BLAINE: Hah! A familiar face\nwith new ideas! Let's put those\pdiscoveries through a proper\nheat test!$

PokemonLeague_BrunosRoom_Text_BlaineDefe.after: A breakthrough! You burned past\nmy expectations!$

PokemonLeague_BrunosRoom_Text_SabrinaInt.after: SABRINA: The arena is full of\nexpectation. Let it pass. Listen\pto your partners, then answer\nme.$

PokemonLeague_BrunosRoom_Text_GiovanniIn.after: GIOVANNI: You taught me what\ncontrol could not achieve.\pToday, my team and I will show\nyou what we have learned.$

PokemonLeague_BrunosRoom_Text_GiovanniDe.after: We have more to learn. A worthy\nresult.$
